title: Grand Mesa Scenic and Historic Byway
direction: Climbs from the Plateau Creek valley over the Grand Mesa, a flat-topped mountain dotted with lakes, and down to Cedaredge. Snow can close the top well into spring.

stretches.title: Up the mesa
stretches.line: The climb out of the valley onto the mesa top.

stretches.title: Down to Cedaredge
stretches.line: Lakes, aspen and the descent south.
